relevant_files.role: LanguageInfo struct definition and get_language_info/get_ts_language functions
ELEMENT_QUERY and DEFUSE_QUERY patterns to model after

conventions.testing: Unit tests in each language handler file with SPDX headers
conventions.error_handling: Option types, expect/unwrap in tests, error messages in production

patterns: LanguageInfo struct with name, language, element_query, call_query, reference_query, import_query, impl_query, impl_trait_query, defuse_query, extract_function_name, find_method_for_receiver, find_receiver_type, extract_inheritance
ELEMENT_QUERY captures function_declaration/class_declaration with name field as @method_name/@class_name
DEFUSE_QUERY covers local_variable_declaration, assignment_expression, update_expression, identifier
EXTENSION_MAP maps file extension to language identifier
get_language_info and get_ts_language match on language name
constraints: tree-sitter-swift 0.7.3 has tree-sitter-language ^0.1.0 as normal dependency only
DEFUSE_QUERY is mandatory field in LanguageInfo
No impl blocks in Swift - set impl_query and impl_trait_query to None
class_declaration covers class/struct/actor/enum/extension via declaration_kind field
test_coverage: Each language handler has unit tests for query compilation and extraction. Java has tests for extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver, extract_inheritance, element_query, and defuse_query.

library_findings.notes: Normal dependency is tree-sitter-language ^0.1.0 only; tree-sitter is dev-only
Workspace dependency, no conflict with tree-sitter-swift

approaches.name: Direct CSS-style minimal handler
approaches.description: Create swift.rs with minimal queries following css.rs pattern, add to EXTENSION_MAP and mod.rs

approaches.name: Java-style full handler
approaches.description: Create swift.rs with full query set following java.rs pattern including extract_inheritance handler

approaches.name: Kotlin-style comprehensive handler
approaches.description: Create swift.rs following kotlin.rs with extensive query coverage and handlers

recommendation: Java-style full handler (approach 2) - Swift shares JVM-inspired structural patterns with Java (named method/function declarations, type inheritance, imports). The issue explicitly recommends modeling after java.rs for reference handler and notes that DEFUSE_QUERY is required.
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}
inheritance_walk_citation: From tree-sitter-swift grammar: Walk inheritance_specifier descendants; for each, read the inherits_from field pointing to a user_type node, then extract the type_identifier or user_type text. Multiple specifiers are siblings under _inheritance_specifiers (comma-separated in source).
